actors_local_name_chars.name: actors_local_name_chars
actors_local_name_chars.value: not "actors"."local" or "actors"."imported_at" is not null or "actors"."kind" = 'Application' or "actors"."name" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,50}$'

modlog_community_ap_id.name: modlog_community_ap_id
modlog_community_ap_id.value: "modlog"."community_id" is null or "modlog"."community_ap_id" is not null

modlog_target_ap_id.name: modlog_target_ap_id
modlog_target_ap_id.value: ("modlog"."target_actor_id" is null and "modlog"."target_post_id" is null and "modlog"."target_comment_id" is null) or "modlog"."target_ap_id" is not null
